description: This file defines an abstract class 'BillingPortalService' that manages Stripe billing portal sessions, including creating portal URLs, building safe return URLs, and processing billing portal requests with permission checks. It also includes related interfaces and imports external dependencies.

classes.name: BillingPortalService
classes.description: An abstract class providing methods to handle Stripe billing portal sessions, including URL creation, URL validation, permission checks, and processing billing portal requests.

methods.name: createBillingPortalUrl
methods.description: Creates a Stripe billing portal URL for a given customer ID and return URL.

methods.name: buildReturnUrl
methods.description: Constructs a safe return URL for the billing portal, defaulting to the billing settings page.

methods.name: getValidatedTeamSubscriptionId
methods.description: Validates and extracts the subscription ID from team metadata.

methods.name: getValidatedTeamSubscriptionIdForPlatform
methods.description: Returns the subscription ID if provided, or null.

methods.name: checkPermissions
methods.description: Abstract method to check user permissions for a team (to be implemented by subclasses).

methods.name: getCustomerId
methods.description: Abstract method to retrieve the customer ID for a team (to be implemented by subclasses).

methods.name: processBillingPortal
methods.description: Handles the billing portal request: permission check, customer ID retrieval, URL creation, and redirect.
